output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: [s01]
Cc: @rafael.ortiz, @ewa.bak
Subject: Re: Ustroń lineup — Liliana Bąk, board 2

Dear Marek,

Thank you for posting the proposed lineup. I would like to raise one point concerning Liliana Bąk's place in it, and I would be grateful if it were considered before the names have to be submitted on Friday 13 November.

On 1 October you set out the selection criteria for this event: the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier of 24 October, with the coaches of the players to be consulted before the final lineup is confirmed. Liliana's coach has not been consulted so far, and I would ask that this step of the procedure be completed before Friday.

On the substance of the decision, I would ask you to look at the whole picture rather than the rating list alone:

- At the rapid qualifier on 24 October, Liliana finished second overall with 5.5/7, ahead of Igor, who scored 4/7. On the criterion you yourself named, she is not behind him.
- The -81 points on the November list come from the Katowice open in early October only. Liliana was already unwell at that event and still played all of her games there, so the drop does not describe her current strength.
- After missing approximately two weeks of training in October for health reasons, she is back to her normal level, and her last three lessons with me were very good.

I have nothing against Igor — he is a good and hard-working young player, and his position on the team is not what I am questioning. My point is about applying the agreed rule consistently, in this case to Liliana.

My request is accordingly simple: Liliana on board 2, or, if you prefer a sporting solution, a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday so that the order of the boards is decided over the board rather than on paper. I would of course be glad to discuss this with you privately as well.

Kind regards,
Oksana Melnyk
